name: Kelly Slater
one_line: World surfing champion at 20 and at 39, winner at Pipeline at 49 - the only athlete to be the best on Earth across three decades of his own aging body.

facts.note: Title years: 1992, 1994-1998, 2005-2006, 2008, 2010-2011. Wikipedia: 'widely regarded as the greatest professional surfer of all time.'

facts.claim: youngest world champion in surfing history at 20, and the oldest at 39
facts.note: 1992 and 2011. BOTH ends of the record. 19 years between first and last title - the core outlier fact: nobody else has been best-on-Earth across their own aging.

facts.claim: the most world titles by anyone else, ever, is 8 - Stephanie Gilmore's women's record; the men's runner-up has 4
facts.note: Gilmore: 8 titles, 8th in 2022, 'most world titles in the history of the women's WSL.' Mark Richards' 4 is the men's second-best. Chart: gold 11 vs gray 8.

facts.claim: 56 championship tour event victories, the all-time record
won the Pipeline Masters eight times, the first in 1992 and the last in 2022 - at 49, days before his 50th birthday, against opponents half his age
facts.note: Pipeline = the most dangerous famous wave in surfing, breaking over shallow reef in Hawaii. 2022 win confirmed; born 11 Feb 1972, final was early Feb 2022. THE story beat: 30 years between first and last win at the same deadly wave.

facts.claim: the only surfer ever to score two perfect 20-point heats
facts.note: May 2005 and June 2013. Two perfect rides in one heat, judged flawless - done twice, by him alone.

facts.claim: retired at the end of 1998 at the top, returned in 2002 - and won five more world titles after coming back
facts.note: Titles 2005, 2006, 2008, 2010, 2011 all post-comeback, in his 30s. The comeback alone would be a career.

facts.claim: born 1972 in Cocoa Beach, Florida; turned professional in 1990
facts.note: Florida kid, not Hawaii royalty - learned on small mushy Atlantic waves.

comparison.second_label: the most by any other man, ever
comparison.gap_description: 11 world titles; no other man in surfing history has more than 4.

story_beat: In February 2022, days before turning fifty, Slater entered the Pipeline Masters - the same deadly Hawaiian wave he had first conquered at twenty - against surfers literally half his age. He won. Thirty years separated his first Pipeline title from his last.
